## GET `/constants/{resource}`

Get static game data mirrored from the dotaconstants repository.

Operation ID: `get_constants_by_resource`.

### SDK call

```ts
const { data, meta } = await client.get("/constants/{resource}", {
  path: { resource: "heroes" },
});
```

### Parameters

#### Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resource` | `string` | Yes | Not specified | Resource name e.g. `heroes`. [List of resources](https://github.com/odota/dotaconstants/tree/master/build) |

Query parameters: none.

### Success response

HTTP `200`; content type `application/json; charset=utf-8`. Success

The SDK resolves to `OpenDotaResult<Data>`. `data` has the shape: String-keyed object of `unknown` or Array of (String-keyed object of `unknown` or `number`) or `null`. `meta` is documented in [Response metadata](../client.md#results-and-metadata).

```ts

type Data = ResponseData<"/constants/{resource}", "get">;
```
